violations.text: Observed employee filling a water pitcher in the handwashing sink in the kitchen. Handwashing sinks must be used for handwashing only. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Observed mussels and clams from different shellstock containers commingled in storage. Molluscan shellfish from one tagged or labeled container must not be mixed with shellfish from another container that has different certification numbers, different harvest dates, or different growing areas as identified on the tag or label. See disposal. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Molluscan Shellfish (clams) located in walk-in cooler did not have the proper identification tags. Molluscan Shellstock tags must remain attached to the container in which the Molluscan Shellstock are received until the container is empty. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Raw animal foods (beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (tortillas) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Establishment to sanitize in 3 bay sink until serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

1) Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. 2) Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of brown biofilm. See disposal. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

Rice and chowder were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2026

The door to the outside, located in the basement, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
Apples were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer moved to warewashing area to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2025

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the sanitizer buckets were 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 150-400 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2025

Chowder, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of food items at the time of inspection. Cooling methods reviewed with staff at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2025

Burn spray was observe stored at the cookline. Employees' medicines must be stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, or utensils. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2025

The following was observed improperly stored: 1) Knives were observed stored in between the flip top prep units 2) Portion containers were used as scoops in dry ingredients Utensils were removed and properly stored at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer was moved to warewashing area to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2024

The dishwasher failed to wash his/her hands between loading soiled and unloading clean dishes from the dishwasher. Food employees must clean their hands after handling soiled equipment or utensils. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

Shellstock tags did not have all of the required information. The last date of sale were lacking.Shellstock tags or labels are required to be maintained for 90 calendar days from the date the container is emptied and dated when the last shellstock is sold. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the flip top prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine and slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of ice and all surfaces were washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

Rice, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Person in charge voluntarily disposed of items at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

Hamburger meat, tomatoes and deli meat was observed held at 43-47 degrees Fahrenheit. Items were double panned in the flip top prep unit. Items were moved to proper refrigeration at the time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

Several food items prepped/cooked on-site (see attached disposal form) were observed with a date mark exceeding 7 days. Items were voluntarily disposed of by person in charge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

The cutting boards in the downstairs prep area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2024
